title: Completeness of Realignment and SIC-POVM Entanglement Tests
exact_target: Determine whether the restricted family of multipartite entanglement testers detects every entangled state, and how output dimension affects testing efficiency.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30004865 (OWR-8415352-007). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Geometry and Optimization in Quantum Information (2021), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2021/49, pp. 2665--2720. Original report and mathematical context.

status_qualification: The primary report asks about the entire family of entanglement testers, with realignment and SIC-POVM tests as examples. It excludes preliminary reshuffling of matrix indices, a broader operation than permuting subsystems. It also asks about output-dimension and efficiency trade-offs. Completeness for a bipartite enlarged family does not settle this restricted multipartite question.
